mentions.name: Agent Friendly Code
mentions.description: This tool tells you which AI coding agent might perform better in your codebase. It scores the codebase for different agents using their static signals and returns a response.
mentions.audience: Developers working on codebases who want to know which AI coding agent might perform better for them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on https://agentfriendlycode.com/

The project lets you find out which agent might perform better in your codebase. It scores the codebase for different agents using their static signals and gives you a response.
